system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: MODIS Vegetation Continuous Fields (VCF) - Tree Cover

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global terrestrial surface coverage at 250m resolution providing continuous estimates of tree cover, non-tree vegetation, and bare ground percentages.

data_description.records: ImageCollection with annual global vegetation cover percentage estimates from 2000 to 2022

Percent_Tree_Cover.description: Percentage of pixel covered by trees (vegetation >5m height)

Percent_NonTree_Vegetation.description: Percentage of pixel covered by herbaceous vegetation and shrubs

Percent_NonVegetated.description: Percentage of pixel that is bare ground, water, or built-up

band_semantics.Percent_Tree_Cover: Continuous percentage estimate (0-100) of tree canopy cover per pixel, where trees are defined as vegetation taller than 5 meters.
band_semantics.Percent_NonTree_Vegetation: Continuous percentage estimate (0-100) of non-tree vegetation including herbaceous plants and shrubs.
band_semantics.Percent_NonVegetated: Continuous percentage estimate (0-100) of bare ground, water bodies, snow/ice, and built-up areas.

data_description.important_note: MODIS VCF provides continuous percentage estimates rather than discrete classes, enabling quantitative analysis of vegetation cover gradients and subtle changes over time. The three bands (tree, non-tree, bare) sum to approximately 100% per pixel.
analytical_capabilities: Continuous tree cover percentage mapping and monitoring
Forest degradation and regrowth gradient analysis
Agricultural expansion quantification via tree cover loss
Biomass estimation and carbon stock assessment
Habitat suitability modeling based on vegetation density

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Percentage (0-100) of pixel area covered by each vegetation type.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use continuous percentage values for gradient analysis; filter by year to track temporal trends in tree cover change.

data_description.data_source: NASA MODIS Terra satellite via Google Earth Engine
